notes: v0 keeps only source assignment, line translation, context refs, and execution guidance.
run_state, reinjection, and reuse are intentionally omitted or left minimal until the first prototype loop is attached.
sample packets are synthetic translations designed to show how Paperclip-style assignments would be converted into vectorfl line-aware work packets.

source_assignment.title: stabilize structured doc routing handoff before next rollout
source_assignment.description: Agent should harden the structured-doc handoff path and keep the runtime surface readable.

translation_reason: the assignment targets handoff stability at the runtime surface boundary
existing runtime tickets already cluster around structured-doc routing
surface readability depends on keeping the transition path stable

execution_guidance.objective: reduce handoff ambiguity without widening the assignment into general runtime refactoring
acceptance_criteria: the handoff path is explicit and bounded
the targeted validation or smoke check passes
new routing residue is not amplified
execution_hints: prefer an edge fix over a broad restructure
capture any unresolved ambiguity as residue rather than hiding it
risk_notes: runtime/core boundary drift can reappear if the change widens
surface output can look stable while the underlying handoff remains implicit

source_assignment.title: shape transcript preprocess guidance for external input ingest
source_assignment.description: Agent should review transcript preprocess cases and tighten the path into readable ingest work.

translation_reason: the assignment is about turning raw transcript material into usable reading input
pre-read and raw-return lines matter because preprocessing can flatten the source too early
the work should improve entry into the reading organ rather than summarize away the source

execution_guidance.objective: improve preprocess guidance without sacrificing raw return and pre-read sensitivity
acceptance_criteria: preprocess guidance names when to stop before over-normalizing
comparison output remains readable and probe-ready
the path into input-to-reading stays explicit
execution_hints: treat preprocessing as shaping, not compression
keep raw-return and pre-read warnings visible
prefer reusable guidance over case-specific patching
risk_notes: over-normalization can erase the line before reread begins
a clean comparison output can still hide source flattening

source_assignment.title: review transition-over-surface validation outputs for reusable cautions
source_assignment.description: Agent should inspect validation results and separate reusable pattern from temporary residue.

translation_reason: the assignment directly reads transition-over-surface validation output
the work is about deciding what becomes reusable caution and what remains residue
raw-return preservation remains relevant when validation summaries risk flattening the original path

execution_guidance.objective: separate stable reusable caution from transient validation residue
acceptance_criteria: temporary residue remains visible instead of being collapsed into the summary
the output can feed a later reinjection step
execution_hints: treat validation output as a reading surface, not just a pass/fail report
promote only patterns that survive reread
leave unresolved edges as residue candidates
risk_notes: validation summaries may hide unstable raw edges
forcing closure too early can destroy future reuse value
